channel.title: Strictly Come Dancing
channel.desc: The Glitterball trophy is now within touching distance. The remaining couples nervously wait to find out who has secured a place in the grand final. Kylie Minogue joins our professionals for a very special group performance, and there's music from Five. Two couples will face the agony of the final dance-off of the series, where the prize is a coveted spot in the Strictly final. Who will make it through and get the chance to compete to be your champion?
